design_name: THE HANGING CLOCK — a bath-suspended two-level clock reading the two-lump induced free energy at earned separation
d1_violations: After real search: no classical form functions as a requirement or a test on any verdict path. V1 is bare existence beyond contact, V2 is bare non-constancy over j, V3-V5 are controls; no exponent, no 1/r, no monotonicity, no metric, no G appears anywhere a verdict is decided, and the design KEEPS the sign-alternating non-monotone shape its own feasibility produced — behavioral evidence D-1 is genuinely not operating, which matters given the program's four prior rediscoveries of this error. Near-misses that are language, not tests, but must still be cleaned: (a) derived reading (b) is labeled "the first force-shaped quantity" — "force" is unearned, and reading (b) is a READ, so under D-24 the label must go even though no verdict uses it (report it as the discrete difference of Delta over separation steps, which is all it is); (b) "tidal instrument" appears once as a successor — acceptable only because naming NEXT earning targets is what D-24 demands, but it must never migrate into a claim; (c) the premise "the mean-force route is how real fields present themselves in open-system physics" imports an operational field-concept from open-system physics as motivation — however, the specific observable it motivates (two-lump induced energy vs separation) is O-39's own named minimum, so this import was made by the ledger row itself, not smuggled by the design. Verdict on D-1: clean on the test path; two wording repairs.
unearned_concepts: (1) d_sep on the joint carrier-tensor-bath venue — the design's own confessed single new concept; earning plan specified (re-run the C-78 axioms battery with a failing control, on the venue where the O-51 amended clauses already live) and the fallback (register UNEARNED, scope to declared bath-graph distance) is stated. Feasible: the C-78 instrument exists and the extension is the C-80 region-separation instrument (w_min), which has precedent. Real hazard, honestly flagged as risk (3): admissibility [U,H_tot]=0 depends on lam and g, so the earned distance may be coupling-dependent — the earning battery must test this explicitly, and if it fires, every separation claim carries the scope forever. (2) "Force" in derived reading (b) — unearned, used in a READ; strip it (see D-1 list). (3) "Tidal" — future-target naming only; earning it is exactly the successor design's job. (4) The bath medium's internal structure (chain graph, hoppings, asymmetric fields w_k) — inserted, and the design says so in the venue section and confesses the inserted sensitivity in risk (6); this follows C-80's own precedent (reach and falloff belong to the coupling, so a field-side instrument NECESSARILY inserts a medium) and is acceptable PROVIDED the scope rides every registered number as a gate, not prose (repair 5). (5) beta/temperature and the free-energy form — owned via C-47's Phi and O-51's declared tolerances; earned enough. (6) Omega, the clock splitting — an instrument parameter whose necessity is computed in-venue (the gauge null), not a surface concept; no earning needed. Nothing else used is unearned.
measurability: YES — and I verified it independently rather than trusting the summaries. Scratchpad rebuild (nB=8 open chain, FRESH asymmetric fields the designer never declared, h=0.5, beta=2, lam=0.6, g=0.3, Omega=0.9): sector reduction exact (probe-half reduction vs full 2^(nB+1) build agrees to 2.7e-15; the carrier half is analytic since [Zbar,H_C]=0); written contrast 1.42e-1 at contact falling sign-alternating to 4.0e-3 at j=7; unwritten F-of-mixture floor 1.8e-7 at j=6 where written reads 3.5e-3 — the D-15 control has real teeth; Omega=0 null machine zero (3.6e-15), with the analytic reason (global X,Y sign flip maps (s,p) to (-s,-p); at Omega=0 the p-sum symmetrizes s) — the clock requirement is a theorem of the venue, not a tuning; probe-only E_ind exactly 0. Dimensions check: all four F terms are energies, E_ind is an energy, same units as C-47's Phi. Compute: 512-dim eigh per sector point, the whole declared grid is minutes; the nB=3 full-venue verification (dim 4096, eigvalsh) is under a minute. ONE REAL GAP: control C3 with A=Xbar BREAKS the Zbar sector reduction (Xbar anticommutes with Zbar), and the full venue at nB=8 is dim 131072 — dense eigh infeasible, so C3 as spec'd cannot run at the stated size. It is rescuable exactly: Tr[Zbar e^{-beta H_tot}] = 0 identically because H_tot is block-diagonal in Xbar sectors while Zbar is block-off-diagonal — an analytic zero, verifiable numerically at nB<=3 full venue; and the stabilizer variant of C3 commutes with Zbar, keeps the reduction, and is the numerically-failable record-blind control at full size. The design must say this (repair 3).
artifact_risks: (1) Medium ownership — the reading could be the declared chain's, with the record reduced to a boundary-condition sign: the design names this itself as the big one, the sign-alternating shape IS manifestly the chain's parity structure, and outcome (B) with its swap test is the guard; residual risk of unresolvable ownership is confessed. (2) Coupling-energetics artifact — caught by a genuinely well-chosen record-blind suite: A=Xbar (writer-symmetric exact zero, O-11's own control), A=stabilizer (the durable-but-carrying-no-written-bit control — this is the one that catches "any conserved contact field would do"), weight-1 coupling (F-17/F-18: entangles but transfers zero record bits, isolating the record-borne part), lam=0, and C4 positive controls beside every claimed zero. (3) Gauge nulls faking negatives — the Omega=0 isospectrality is found, proved, and turned into a design requirement; other undetected isospectralities on other media remain possible, mitigated by C4, honestly not eliminated. (4) NOT caught by the controls as spec'd, needs repair: (a) V1's tolerance is a machine-zero literal (1e-10) while the unwritten control's own floor is ~1e-7 — a written reading of 1e-8 would pass V1 while sitting below the control floor; D-8's noise-floor-beside-the-verdict rule requires V1 to beat the MEASURED unwritten floor at the same j and grid point (repair 1); (b) the unwritten reading has two inequivalent definitions (free energy of the even mixture vs even mixture of the free energies) and the design says "at the free-energy level" without fixing one — must be pre-registered as a single formula or the choice can be made after seeing the numbers (repair 2); (c) the C3 compute-path break (see measurability). (5) Inserted sensitivity via asymmetric bath fields — confessed in risk (6), answered by the m-sweep and which-record tests; if those fail the design says the sensitivity is confessed as inserted, which is the correct disposition.
is_it_actually_a_field: Mostly yes, with one honest concession the design under-states. FOR: the reading is indexed by a place j that is not the source's, V2 requires it to VARY with that place, and the probe touches only bath operators with support disjoint from source contact and carrier — this is the genuine step past C-47's registered limitation (Phi read AT the sources, no place-index at all), and it is precisely the two-lump induced energy as a function of separation that O-39 names as its own minimum, so the design meets the row's bar by the row's own words. AGAINST, and this must be said plainly: (a) my rebuild confirms [Z_P, H_tot]=0 — the probe's bit is itself a conserved, durable quantity, so the instrument is literally two commuting lumps interacting through a shared bath, not a moving object feeling a condition; that is exactly O-39's minimum, but the "clock reads the field at its location" narrative overstates it; (b) E_ind is a GLOBAL four-term free-energy subtraction over the whole joint spectrum, symmetric under exchanging the source and probe roles — nothing in the static number distinguishes "the record produces a condition at j which the probe reads" from "the pair has a joint energy" (that symmetry is Casimir's own situation, so the borrowing is at least honest). The one-place, one-lump-conditioned content — a condition existing AT j — is carried by the companions the design already includes: chi(record:probe) via F-17's own instrument (does an object at j come to HOLD record information) and the record-conditioned dephasing of the |+>-prepared clock. E_ind alone is a two-body interaction energy; E_ind PLUS the companions is a field-side case. So: it is not another source-quantity in disguise (V2's j-dependence at fixed source excludes that, and the m-sweep measures amount without assuming linearity), it is the field side in the only sense the program has earned the right to ask for — and outcome (B) correctly concedes the field, if present, may belong to the inserted medium, which C-80 says is the only place reach could ever have lived.
salvage: Five repairs, all specification-level, none structural: (1) D-8: re-state V1's boolean against the measured unwritten floor at the same j and grid point (e.g. |Delta_written(j)| > K x |E_ind_unwritten(j)| with pre-registered K), keeping the 1e-10 literal only for the true machine-zero controls (C2, gauge null, C3-analytic). (2) Pre-register ONE exact formula for the unwritten reading (F-of-mixture or mixture-of-F) before the lane runs. (3) Amend the venue section: C3 with A=Xbar breaks the sector reduction — run it full-venue at nB<=3 plus the exact analytic identity Tr[Zbar e^{-beta H_tot}]=0 (Xbar-sector block structure), and promote the stabilizer coupling to the full-size, reduction-compatible, numerically-failable record-blind control. (4) D-24 wording: strip "force-shaped" from derived reading (b) and keep "tidal" strictly as the name of a next earning target, out of every claim and READ. (5) Make the medium-scope a gate: every registered number carries "joint property of (written record + declared medium + declared contacts)", and if the d_sep earning battery fails or comes out coupling-dependent, the separation scope attaches mechanically, not editorially. The honest_risks audit: the six named risks are the real ones, not decorative — (1) is correctly called the big one, (4) firewalls "a field side" from "the emergent field", (6) confesses the inserted sensitivity; missing and to be added: the global-vs-local point (E_ind is a joint spectral quantity, not a probe-local read — the local statics/dynamics live in the companions) and the C3 reduction break. Relevance-test audit: borrowings (1),(2),(3),(5) name the program variable first — pass; (4) names its mapping before owners but maps to a construct of this design — tie it explicitly to F-17's chi and O-11's record-conditioned mean-force state. With these repairs the design goes to the lane; my independent scratchpad replication on fresh parameters (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-bgm-MB-Work/04dac55c-b963-46a5-9ea4-74afb63af51b/scratchpad/t51_audit_check.py) already shows the effect is structural, the controls have teeth, and every verdict can come out the other way.

design_name: THE HANGING CLOCK — bath-suspended two-level clock reading the two-lump induced free energy at earned separation
d1_violations: None found as a requirement or test after a real search. The verdict logic (V1-V5, meaning A/B/C) is existence-and-tolerance booleans only; no exponent, falloff, 1/r, G, metric, geodesic, or monotonicity appears on any verdict path, and the sign-alternating chain-parity shape the feasibility run produces would fail any gravity-shaped prior — the design correctly keeps that legal. Two near-misses examined and cleared: (1) 'for a gapped medium the contrast likely decays exponentially' in risk (4) is a prediction inside a risk note, not a test; (2) 'the first force-shaped quantity' is a units statement (energy per unit separation, a discrete difference), not a form assumption. One borrowing-discipline nick adjacent to D-1: the successor 'tidal instrument' in meaning (A) is a borrowed concept used without an owner or a program-variable mapping — either run it through the relevance test or strike the word.
unearned_concepts: (1) d_sep, the one concept the design says it will earn — THE NAMED EARNING STEP CANNOT RUN AS SPECIFIED. C-78's battery takes configurations and admissible writers (d_W = minimal admissible-writer cost); C-80's region form (w_min = d) enumerates admissible coupling-writers on a Gamma carrier. The declared chain medium supplies neither: with H_B = sum w_k Z_k + h sum(XX+YY), the only conserved structure is global (total magnetization plus functions of H), so there are essentially no LOCAL admissible unitaries on the bath graph and a w_min enumeration between contact regions returns no writers at any weight — the battery does not fail gracefully, it is undefined on this venue. The design's own fallback (declared bath-graph distance, registered UNEARNED) is not a contingency; it is the only path, and should be registered as such from the start. (2) The probe itself is an inserted primitive — nothing on the surface earns 'a test object with a splitting'; it is honestly an instrument, but it should be DECLARED exactly as the medium is (the design declares the medium and forgets to declare the probe). (3) beta and the free-energy functional are already in-program (C-47's Phi is literally this form; O-51 makes T a declared tolerance) — earned/owned. (4) The chain medium is inserted and says so, with C-80 as precedent — acceptable. (5) 'Tidal response' — borrowed without owner or mapping, see D-1 field. Earning feasibility: (1) is not feasibly earned by any instrument the program owns today; scope-as-declared is the honest registration.
measurability: RUNS, verified by running it (scratchpad t51_check.py, this machine): nB=8 sector-reduced venue = 2^9 = 512-dim eigh; the full 7-separation table with all four free energies per point took 8.8 s; Delta(j) resolvable at every j (8.3e-2 at j=1, sign-alternating, 5.0e-3 at j=7) against an annealed unwritten baseline decaying 1.8e-3 to 4.0e-7 — the design's claimed feasibility numbers are credible (same orders at the stated parameters). Omega=0 gauge null confirmed twice: analytically (G = prod Z_k composed with X_P maps H(s) to H(-s) exactly iff Omega=0) and numerically (7.1e-15). C2 probe-only subtraction: exactly 0. Dimension arithmetic checks: nB=3 full venue 256x8x2 = 4096, one dense eigh ~1 min, feasible; nB=10 reduced = 2048-dim, but the full declared grid (3 beta x 3 h x 2 Omega x 7 j x ~4 states) is tens of minutes at nB=10, not 'minutes' — same order, slightly optimistic. Machinery: Environment.holevo/formation/evolve exist (model/record_model.py:298-533); the O-11 lane already computes mean-force states on toric-2x2 with the same closed-form cross-check; the chain-medium Environment (hopping terms) is NEW code, small and honestly costed. The one computation the design needs but does not cost: the second venue with a NON-record-diagonal source coupling (required to make outcome (A) reachable, see field question) — 256 x 2^nB x 2 = 8192-dim at nB=4 (~10 min, ~1 GB) to 16384-dim at nB=5 (~1 h, ~12 GB with workspace): feasible, must be added explicitly.
artifact_risks: Four, two of which the design's controls do NOT catch as written. (1) VALUE-ODD SIGNAL, uncaught: my run shows E_ind(+1,j) and E_ind(-1,j) are near-opposite at every j — the reading is dominated by the record's VALUE (odd in s), while the PRESENCE response (even part; the unwritten-with-coupling reading) is separate, smaller, faster-decaying (1.8e-3 falling to 4e-7). Two lumps written with opposite values SCREEN; the m-sweep amount axis will measure value configuration, not amount. Repair: pre-register the odd/even-in-s split as two named readings; the even part is O-39's presence quantity. This is also a finding, not a flaw: the field-side reading is sign-INDEFINITE where the anchor's source standard was sign-definite — registrable structure either way. (2) UNWRITTEN CONVENTION, uncaught: quenched (F_+ + F_-)/2 vs annealed -(1/beta)ln[(Z_+ + Z_-)/2] give Deltas differing by ~9% of signal at contact (-8.32e-2 vs -7.63e-2 in my run). Since the sector is superselected, quenched is physically right, but one convention must be pre-registered — this ambiguity is at tolerance scale. (3) C3 IS DECORATION: both named record-blind couplings (Xbar and a stabilizer) give contrast EXACTLY zero by algebra — conjugation by Xbar (which commutes with H_tot under either coupling and anticommutes with Zbar) forces Tr[Zbar e^{-beta H}] = 0 identically. V3 cannot come out the other way — a D-8 violation as a verdict and, per the design's own D-15 standard, a control that passes under both hypotheses. The only artifact control with teeth is the F-17 weight-1 variant (full venue, non-commuting) plus the even-part baseline; promote those to primary C3. (4) MEDIUM-SHAPE: the j-dependence is the declared chain's parity structure — the design owns this fully (risk 1, outcome B). The declared asymmetric w_k inserted sensitivity is confessed in risk 6. Controls C1/C2/C4 and the gauge-null discipline are genuinely good and verified.
is_it_actually_a_field: Half yes, and the half matters. YES, it is a reading at a place: E_ind is probe-position-resolved (its j-dependence is the probe's location), vanishes identically when the probe decouples (C2, exact), decays with declared separation, and is the first probe-evaluated quantity in the program — C-47 read at the sources, this reads at j. It is not a source-quantity in disguise by the operational tests. BUT the exact sector reduction — the very identity that makes the venue cheap — is a proof that on venue 1 the field side belongs to the MEDIUM, not the record surface: because the source coupling commutes with H_C, the entire 256-dim carrier CANCELS out of the four-term subtraction (I verified the algebra; the static computation never touches the carrier Hilbert space), and the written content enters the observable as the c-number boundary field s*lam at bath site 0. Consequence the design half-sees but understates: its own outcome-(B) swap test (record replaced by a fixed boundary condition of matched strength) is not a discriminator on venue 1 — it is DEGENERATE BY IDENTITY; the sector reduction IS the swap. So outcome (A) 'the record surface has a field side' is algebraically unreachable on the first venue; the honest venue-1 headline is (B): a declared medium has a field side and the record supplies one classical bit of boundary data plus a strength — which is C-77-consistent (Gamma gives sources, the coupling/bath gives reach) and still delivers O-39's named minimum, the two-lump induced energy vs separation. Additionally 'away' is declared-graph distance, not earned (see unearned). To make (A) reachable at all, the source coupling must fail to commute with H_C (e.g., a writer-adjacent weight-d coupling) so carrier structure survives into the reduced dynamics — full venue at nB=4-5, feasible, currently absent from the design.
salvage: Four repairs, all cheap, none touching the instrument's core. (1) Rewrite the meaning clause: venue-1's ceiling is outcome (B) by algebraic identity (sector reduction = the swap test); state it, and name the second venue — non-record-diagonal source coupling at nB=4-5, full-venue eigh, honestly costed above — as the only path to outcome (A). (2) Pre-register the unwritten convention (quenched, with the annealed number computed beside it) and the odd/even-in-s split of Delta as two named readings — presence and value — with the m-sweep verdicts stated per-part. (3) Demote the Xbar/stabilizer C3 controls to code-validation zeros (they are unfailable identities, D-8) and promote the F-17 weight-1 full-venue variant plus the unwritten-with-coupling baseline to the primary coupling-artifact control. (4) Register d_sep as DECLARED/UNEARNED from the outset — the C-78 battery cannot run on the medium (no local admissible writers exist on the declared chain; conserved-charge argument) — and scope every separation claim accordingly, or specify a genuinely new earning instrument as its own task.

d1_violations: Searched the full design text for every banned form (r^-2, 1/r, exponent, G, metric, geodesic, deflection, Newton-shaped requirement) and for softer smuggles (a pre-registered sign, monotonicity, or falloff family; a fit of any response coefficient; "should look like" phrasing in the verdict branches). None found. The response claim is existence-only with sign/magnitude/reach as outputs; the observed t-dependent sign flips are used as an argument AGAINST pre-registration, which is the right direction; the contact-only middle verdict is explicitly kept as a real verdict per C-80's precedent rather than a failure; the FIELD-SIDE-EXISTS branch requires only floor-clearing at positive earned separation on two carriers, no shape. The one borderline phrase — DEF_W as "O-39's minimum ask with bits substituted for energy" — describes O-39's own text and imposes no classical form. Empty of violations after real search.
unearned_concepts: (1) Access-geometry distance (bath adjacency, and which fragments are "accessible from A"): declared, not earned — the design names it plainly and routes its earning to the world tier's counted geometry; that route is honest but uncosted and the design's own risk 2 admits it may fail. Acceptable as a declared quantity at first-computation tier. (2) THE CARRIER PREPARATION ENSEMBLE p(s): load-bearing and NOWHERE DECLARED — this is the unearned concept the design missed. "Half-written probe" and "C written vs unwritten" are only well-defined relative to an ensemble over configurations, and my Check 2 shows the ensemble choice alone can manufacture the entire reading (see artifact_risks). RecordModel.evolve's DEFAULT state0 is the ground-space projector, which on the named Ising-ring venue is the 2-dim all-up/all-down mixture — a maximally correlated prior in which probe and content are THE SAME BIT (the n=5 ring ground space holds one logical bit total; there is no room for independent A and C in it). The ensemble must be declared (product/uniform over unwritten sites is the natural choice), entered in the CHOICE LEDGER, and defended — noting C-91 already flagged ensemble-weight symmetry as unearned extra data, so this is a known program-wide gap, not a new one. Earning it fully is not feasible at first-computation tier; declaring it is, and suffices. (3) W and t_epoch: declared tolerances per the amended-clause discipline; the clock CONCEPT is earned (C-83); the specific value is a declaration and the design says so. Acceptable. (4) Joint-sector Holevo for DEF_W: chi is earned (F-17/F-21 lineage, the URM's own), but env.holevo takes a single ±1 observable; the two-lump deficit needs a 4-sector (joint eigenspace) Holevo the model does not have. A ~10-line extension of earned machinery — feasible, but currently unnamed in the design. (5) Bits as the currency and CERT itself: earned (F-17/F-21; C-81/82/83), attribution already in-row. Clean.
measurability: Ran the arithmetic (scratchpad script t51_skeptic_check.py, read-only imports of model/record_model.py). FAILS AS LITERALLY SPECIFIED, RUNS AFTER SMALL REPAIRS: (a) "records found first-principles by RecordModel.records(), never inserted" CRASHES on the named venue. Ising ring n=5: for Ls=() (no noise), Ls={Z_i} (site dephasing), and Ls={Z_iZ_{i+1}} (bond dephasing) the commutant's generic element has 32 minimal projections in every case, and records() raises RuntimeError at its hard k>20 cap. This is structural, not a tuning issue: the count of minimal projections is the sum of commutant block ranks, which is 32 for every diagonal-record noise declaration on dim 32. The records themselves EXIST — Z_0 passes clauses (i)-(iv) exactly by the model's own public clause functions (involution defect 0.0, [H,Z_0]=0.0, clause_iii True, clause_iv True by flip-symmetric trace balance) — it is only the enumerator that cannot list them. The sanctioned alternative route, symplectic_logicals on the ring's bond-stabiliser presentation, yields exactly ONE logical bit (rank-4 stabiliser on 5 qubits), leaving no independent content region C. So the venue as named cannot deliver probe + content by either existing first-principles route; repair required (see salvage). (b) Compute cost: CONFIRMED. One evolve+holevo at the named size (n=5 carrier x nq=5 bath, total dim 1024, exact eigendecomposition) took 0.72 s; the ~200-cell grid is minutes, as claimed. The nq sweep arithmetic: eigh cost scales 8x per added bath qubit; nq=7 is ~30 s/evolution, nq=8 ~4 min/evolution — "unaffordable past nq=6" is right for full grids, though reduced grids at nq=7-8 are affordable. Toric-2x2 x nq=5 registration venue is dim 8192, ~1-5 min/evolution — feasible for a reduced grid. (c) The Environment extension (bath adjacency g, transverse hx, unequal energies) does not exist in the model — Environment.HB is currently non-interacting — but is a ~10-line subclass, honestly costed by the design as "extended"; I built it in the scratchpad and it works with the existing distributed-coupling form [(Z_i, i)], which formation/evolve already accept. (d) DEF_W is NOT computable with existing holevo (single binary observable); needs the joint-sector extension, and its arms are ambiguous as written: with C written definite, CERT_dyn(C)=0 structurally (holevo returns 0 for a single sector), so the two-lump deficit only means something with BOTH lumps half-written — the design must say so. (e) The corner arm is genuinely cheap and provable: CERT=cut-rank (C-81) depends only on the stabiliser group and the region by construction, and LANE_T43_A machinery exists at the named L. (f) Units check: chi is in bits, bounded by 1 for a binary record; observed magnitudes (0.43 baseline, 8.4e-4 shadow at bath-distance 2 on my 3+3 toy) are consistent with the design's claimed ~1e-2 at distance 2-3 on its larger parameters. Dimensions all line up (n=5 sites <-> nq=5 private attachments).
artifact_risks: (1) THE CONDITIONING ARTIFACT — demonstrated, and the design's eight controls DO NOT catch it. If the carrier ensemble correlates A's record with C's content, "writing C" reweights the probe's sectors and chi moves for purely informational reasons, with no mediation at all. Measured on the mini venue: correlated (GHZ-diagonal ground-space) prior, g=0 DISCONNECTED bath, private attachments — SHADOW = -0.430 bits, the probe's p+ moving 0.5 -> 1.0, on a geometry where the design asserts an exact null. That is the same order as the design's headline -0.38-bit contact shadow, so the exploration numbers are not interpretable until the prior is declared. The g=0 null is NOT structurally exact — it is exact only under an uncorrelated prior (verified: uniform prior gives SHADOW = 2.8e-16 at g=0, and a genuine -8.4e-4 bits at bath-distance 2 once the bath chain is connected, confirming the mechanism and D-8 both-directions). The catch is a NEW control the design lacks: probe-marginal invariance — report p±(A) and Tr(rho R_A) for written vs unwritten in the same table; any shift above machine zero invalidates the cell. With that control and a declared product ensemble, this artifact is fully caught. (2) Bath-capacity competition (the design's own risk 4): a global shared-reservoir depletion would mimic a shadow but be separation-independent at fixed bath size — the separation grid plus the nq sweep discriminate it; adequately controlled if the verdict requires separation-DEPENDENCE, which the response claim already does. (3) Diagonal-venue degeneracy: on the named venue everything is diagonal (Ising H, Z couplings), so H_tot is block-diagonal over carrier configurations — carrier populations are frozen and the written content enters ONLY as classical parameters steering a family of bath Hamiltonians H_B(s). The first venue therefore cannot distinguish "the record surface has a field side" from "a classically parametrized bath family responds to its parameters". Not fatal — the toric registration venue has non-diagonal record structure and carries that weight — but the first-computation verdict must be scoped as instrument-viability only, which the design's TOY_SEPARATION language already does. (4) The noise-floor control (6) is undefined as written: on an exact venue there is no sampling noise, and "two irrelevant-microstate variants of the unwritten surface" names no computable procedure on a declared-ensemble venue (the natural candidate, config vs globally-flipped config, is already control 5's gauge check). Replace with: floor := max over the exact-null rows (g=0, footprint, marginal-invariance defects), which my run puts at ~1e-15 — so the real discriminating work is done by the artifact controls, not the floor, and the design should say so. (5) Window-shopping: guarded only procedurally by pre-declared W; the observed t-dependent sign flips make this the likeliest honest-mistake channel; the guard is a declaration and the design admits it. (6) Coupling-footprint control (3) is sound as designed (written-vs-unwritten at fixed attachment). Probe-only control (2) passes under both hypotheses — it is instrument sanity, not a discriminator, and should be labeled as such per D-15/D-8.
is_it_actually_a_field: Argued: YES, structurally — this is the first design in the program whose reading is taken at a place where the source is not, and it survives the disguise test after repair. The observable chi(R_A : accessible fragment) is a property of the probe's locale: the probe record at A and the environment fragment adjacent to A, at positive earned carrier separation (C-78 lineage) and positive declared access distance from C. The reading responds to C's presence at fixed instrument, and cutting the connection (g=0) provably factorizes it to an exact zero — influence-at-a-place with a working absence control, which is exactly the logical shape C-47 lacked (C-47 read the potential AT the sources; this reads a change AT A). It is not another source-quantity in costume: a source-quantity is an integral over the written content's own region, and SHADOW is instead a difference of A-local readings — the written content appears in it only through what arrives at A. The two ways it could secretly be source-side are both identified and controllable: (a) sector-reweighting of the probe (then it is A's own prior, not a received influence — caught by the probe-marginal control, which must be ADDED, see repairs); (b) global reservoir depletion (then it is a property of the shared bath as a whole, position-free — caught by requiring separation-dependence and the nq sweep). The honest conditional the design itself states and I confirm: the mediation lives entirely in the DECLARED bath adjacency, so at first-computation tier the instrument measures "field through a declared medium", and every reach statement is conditional on that declaration until the world tier counts the geometry. is_it_actually_a_field: Structurally yes, conditionally — and it is the first design in the program for which the argument can even be made. FOR: the reading is taken AT A, not at C. The probe is a genuine test object in the program's own sense (a record of the venue, found not inserted, half-written so certification has something to certify — and the structural chi=0 of a definite-valued or absent probe is the right probe-only control). The subtraction at fixed A-instrument removes A's own source content, so what remains is not A's source-quantity and not C's source-quantity: it is C's influence at A's place. That is the field-side structure O-39 asks for, in the surface's earned currency. AGAINST, and this is the real objection: the PLACE is a place on a declared graph. "Where" is the unearned coordinate — at first-computation tier the observable is "what this declared wire carries between two attachments," a property of an engineered environment as much as of the record surface, and on the classical-ring venue the carrier provably contributes no mediation at all (all Z's conserved; verified). The weaker objection, that chi(R_A:fragment) is a joint probe-medium property, does not disqualify: every field reading is a joint property of test object and medium. Net: influence-at-a-place is genuinely measured; field-OF-THE-SURFACE is earned only if the geometry-earning step lands, and the design says so itself. That is an honest advance over every prior lane, including C-47.
